name: mistral-api-playground
description: Minimal no-framework web UI for the Mistral API — calls are made directly from the browser with the official TypeScript SDK; the server only serves the static interface

scripts.build: sass src/client/styles.scss public/styles.css --no-source-map && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && esbuild src/client/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/js/app.js
